_new_flags_for_pm.title: Berridge C-Lock in the GMP reverses RFI #23
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: Clarification No.1 RFI #23 answered that spec 07 61 00 (MBCI PBR panel BOD) takes precedence over the plan callout of Berridge Cee-lock. The GMP is priced on the Berridge C-Lock system. The GMP is later and the PM directs it supersedes, but this overturns a written architect's RFI answer. Confirm before RFP-045 issues.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Door 106 panic hardware exclusion is ambiguous
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: The exclusion reads: 'Panic hardware at Door 106 per Door Schedule Remark 2. Hardware provided per specification section 08711 Door Hardware, Hardware Set 01'. It is unclear whether panic hardware is excluded outright, or whether Remark 2's hardware is excluded and Hardware Set 01 substituted. Door 106 is the concessions overhead counter shutter area and this is a life-safety item.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Trash receptacle exclusion vs the CFCI Site Equipment Matrix
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: Excludes 'Trash receptacles at Restrooms or elsewhere in buildings'. Sheet A1-20's Site Equipment Matrix designates a Trash Receptacle as CFCI under ITB-018 Site Furnishings. Site receptacles appear to remain in scope while building ones are out — confirm the boundary so ITB-018 is not written to include both or neither.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Several ITB packages are unaddressed by the Basis of GMP
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: No scope assumption or exclusion covers ITB-008 Surveying, ITB-019 Track & Field Athletic Equipment (beyond excluding soccer goals), ITB-040, ITB-044, ITB-056, ITB-062, ITB-071, ITB-072, or ITB-085 Warming Kitchen Food Service Equipment. With 'Loose FF&E' excluded, whether the warming kitchen equipment is in or out is not established.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Final cleaning likely sits in CORE's General Conditions
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: The 1% listing shows CORE Construction self-performing 'General Conditions & Requirements' (license 0006144A). That is the probable home of the '070 Final Cleaning' proposals that match no package — review-packet item B2. Confirm.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Owner Accepted Alternates supersede drawn details
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: Six Owner Accepted Alternates change scope from the bid set: RCP flared end replaces the CIP concrete headwall detail; access road grading removed; bleacher footings per manufacturer design replace the drawn foundation design; manual galvanized OH doors replace motorized aluminum; sealed concrete replaces epoxy/resinous flooring; one flagpole instead of three. Every exhibit citing the superseded detail must reflect the alternate.

_new_flags_for_pm.title: Asbestos survey date differs from the staged file
_new_flags_for_pm.detail: The exclusion cites the EICS Pre-Demolition Asbestos Survey dated October 3, 2023. The staged file is '04.03 - Asbestos Survey_EICS 100323.pdf' — 10/03/23, consistent. Quantities beyond that survey are excluded, so the survey's quantities are the contractual baseline for RFP-002.
